info.name: JubeeX Parse API
info.description:
HTTP API for the JubeeX Parse microservice (`src/extraction_review/api.py`).

Use this collection from the application layer. All long-running work returns **202** `{ job_id, poll_url }` — poll `GET /v1/jobs/{{job_id}}` until `status` is `completed` or `failed`.

**Recommended frontend flow**
1. `POST /v1/filings/split-petition` — LlamaSplit Main Petition (no classify). Poll → `parts` / `page_span`.
2. `POST /v1/filings/verify-document` — check named PDFs vs split categories. Poll → `{ type: DocumentsVerified, match, documents:[{name, match}] }`.
3. `POST /v1/filings/extract` — parse extract-source slots, LlamaExtract, skip Pinecone. Poll → save **`agent_data_id`** and **`result.parsed_slots`** in your DB.
4. `POST /v1/filings/{{agent_data_id}}/index` — reuse S3 markdown (unless `edited: true`, then omit `parsed_slots` and re-parse every PDF), parse the rest, Pinecone, then scrutiny defects. Optional `special_category` (`null` skips tagged specials). Poll `completed` → `result.report`. Findings use `check_id`; there is no `serial_no`. If `failed` with `Unable to run scrutiny defects. Try after some time.`, indexing already happened — retry **only** step 5. Do not re-run index.
5. `POST /v1/filings/{{agent_data_id}}/scrutiny` — defects-only retry (old API). Use after a failed index poll, or to re-run defects later.

**Auth:** if `JUBEEX_API_KEY` is set, send `X-API-Key` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
Do not wrap bodies in `start_event`. Do not send `handler_id`.
Replace example `download_url` values with real HTTPS/S3 URLs.

While a job is in process, `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}` returns HTTP 200 with `status: "running"` and `result: null`. Keep polling until `completed` or `failed`.

request.description:
`job_type=split_petition`. Ingests the compiled Main Petition PDF, **skips LlamaClassify**, runs LlamaSplit + slice.

`filing_type` is required.
Poll result: `BundlePrepared` with `parts[]` (`slot_id`, `label`, `page_span`, sliced `file_id`) plus leftover `undefined` pages.
Does not parse, extract, or index.

**Example responses:** open this request in Postman and use the **Examples** dropdown (202 Accepted, then the GET /v1/jobs poll body you actually consume).

While the job is still working, poll returns HTTP 200 with `status: "running"`, `result: null`, `agent_data_id: null`. Keep polling until `completed` or `failed`. On failure the same poll returns HTTP 200 with `status: "failed"` and an `error` string.

request.description:
`job_type=verify_document`. Each PDF is LlamaSplit independently against its filename (`cover_page.pdf` → `cover_page`). Optional explicit `slot_id` wins.

Poll `result` is **only**:
```json
{ "type": "DocumentsVerified", "match": false, "documents": [{ "name": "cover_page.pdf", "match": true }] }
```
Overall `match` is true only if every file matches.

**Example responses:** open this request in Postman and use the **Examples** dropdown (202 Accepted, then the GET /v1/jobs poll body you actually consume).

While the job is still working, poll returns HTTP 200 with `status: "running"`, `result: null`, `agent_data_id: null`. Keep polling until `completed` or `failed`. On failure the same poll returns HTTP 200 with `status: "failed"` and an `error` string.

item.name: 3 Extract only (parse extract sources, no Pinecone)

request.description:
`job_type=extract_only`. Parses **extract-source slots only** (Cover Page, Main Petition, Vakalatnama, AOR’s Certificate, Impugned Order) in `documents[]` send order. Runs LlamaExtract. **Skips Pinecone.** Writes the extracted JSON to S3.

**Completed poll does not include cause_title / petitioners / respondents.** It returns the S3 location:
- `result.extract.url` — presigned GET of the uploaded extract JSON
- `result.extract.key` — `extractedfiles/.../agent-extract-....json`
- `result.extract.filing_key` — stable `filings/{agent_data_id}/extract.json`
- `result.artifacts.extract` — same extract upload (when S3 job artifacts are recorded)

Download that JSON (or later `GET /v1/filings/{agent_data_id}`) for `data.data.cause_title`, `petitioners`, `respondents`, `relief_sort`.

**Also persist in your DB:**
- top-level `agent_data_id`
- `result.parsed_slots`
- `result.filing_type`
Do not store markdown; it is already on S3.

While the job is still working, poll returns HTTP 200 with `status: "running"`, `result: null`, `agent_data_id: null`. Keep polling until `completed` or `failed`. On failure the same poll returns HTTP 200 with `status: "failed"` and an `error` string.

request.description:
`job_type=index_parsed`. Always after extract. Path `agent_data_id` is required.

This job parses, upserts Pinecone, then runs the defect checks. Send `special_category` here. It is not a query parameter.

- `special_category` — one optional matter subtype, or `null`. Omit the key, `null`, or `"N/A"` to skip every defect that has a special category. Case and punctuation do not matter (`"APPEAL ARMED FORCES"` is the same as `"Appeal (Armed Forces)"`). Unknown text is ignored, not guessed.
- Allowed values are on `GET /v1/catalog` under `special_categories.SLP_CIVIL` (and the other filing-type keys). Exact labels: `Appeal (Armed Forces)`, `Bail Applications/Bail Matters`, `Civil Appeal with High Court Certificate`, `Criminal Appeal with High Court Certificate`, `Demolition Matters`, `Eviction Matters`, `Indigent person`, `Interlocutory Applications`, `Jail Petition`, `Matters involving/pertaining to minors`, `Miscellaneous Application`, `Motor Vehical Act`, `PIL`, `Re-filing defect`.
- `edited: false` — reuse S3 markdown for `parsed_slots`, LlamaParse the rest. Echo `parsed_slots` from extract, or omit it to fall back to Agent Data metadata.
- `edited: true` / `"yes"` — re-download and re-parse **every** PDF in `documents[]`. Do **not** re-extract. **Omit `parsed_slots`**. Do not send a placeholder.
- `documents[]` **send order** sets global page numbers. Newly inserted files (index, annexures) shift later pages.

Poll until `completed` (`result.report`) or `failed`. Findings use `check_id` (for example `D063`). There is no `serial_no`.
If poll `status` is `failed` and `error` is `Unable to run scrutiny defects. Try after some time.`, Pinecone already ran — retry **only** `POST /v1/filings/{agent_data_id}/scrutiny` and send the same `special_category`. Do not call `/index` again.

**Example responses:** open this request in Postman and use the **Examples** dropdown (202 Accepted, then the GET /v1/jobs poll body you actually consume).

While the job is still working, poll returns HTTP 200 with `status: "running"`, `result: null`, `agent_data_id: null`. Keep polling until `completed` or `failed`. On failure the same poll returns HTTP 200 with `status: "failed"` and an `error` string.

item.description: Defect check against an extracted filing. Returns 202; poll GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}. Examples include in progress, completed (`result.report`), and failed.

request.description:
Runs scrutiny on the extracted Agent Data record. Body is optional (`file_hash`, `file_url`/`download_url`, org/workspace).
Poll Get job status. Report is `result.report`.
Rejected filings return 409.
Use this old API after a failed index job whose `error` is `Unable to run scrutiny defects. Try after some time.` Do not re-run `/index`.

Poll `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}` until `completed` or `failed`. While working: HTTP 200, `status: "running"`, `result: null`. On failure: HTTP 200, `status: "failed"`, read `error`.

response.description: Immediate response. Copy `job_id` and poll GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}.

response.description: Job is still working. HTTP is 200; keep polling. `agent_data_id`, `result`, and `error` are null. `completed_at` is null. Do not treat this as success. Poll again until `status` is `completed` or `failed`.
